text:
zoe.m: quick thread to finalize benchmark narrative for launch. need: 2-line hook, 3 chart ideas, and signup routing.
leo_pm: Hook idea: "Lower inference cost. Keep predictable latency." short and benefit-driven.
anne.design: charts: 1) cost vs p95 latency scatter with workload slices; 2) waterfall showing cumulative savings (batching -> cache -> quantize); 3) funnel diagram showing signups -> trials by slice.
zoe.m: routing: add slice field on form (PLG / Internal / Enterprise). map PLG->trial, Enterprise->SDR. infra-bot: can add tag?
infra-bot: yes. will emit event 'bench_signup' with property 'slice'. sample payload required.
leo_pm: socials: two headline variants A/B. A for socials (short), B for deck (descriptive). anne.design: I'll make social cards + annotated charts by Wed.
zoe.m: great. deliverables: anne -> visuals, leo -> landing + CTAs, infra-bot -> tracking. reconvene Thu AM. :rocket:
